The error comes from the literal word "input" in a comment ("# input pair"), which the program checker treats as a forbidden I/O construct. This edit removes that word and drops the dead `m3` lines. It also moves the tail-node assumption to about 0.3 V and tidies the phase-margin prediction. The topology stays the same: a two-stage Miller amp with an NMOS pair and RZ–CC compensation.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Checker rejected the word 'input' in a comment. Removed it and the junk m3 lines, set tail vds to a realistic ~0.3 V, and cleaned up the PM prediction. Topology (two-stage Miller, NMOS pair, PMOS mirror, RZ-CC) is unchanged; first-order numbers suggest all specs can be met at ~0.55 mW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gbw":    (14e6, 10e6, 30e6),
    "Cc":     (3e-12, 1e-12, 6e-12),
    "gmid1":  (15, 10, 20),
    "L1":     (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),
    "gmid3":  (6, 4, 10),
    "L3":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "I7":     (250e-6, 80e-6, 400e-6),
    "gmidn":  (12, 8, 16),
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "kz":     (1.0, 0.6, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    gm1_t = 2*PI*p["gbw"]*Cc
    I1 = gm1_t / p["gmid1"]
    Itail = 2*I1
    I7 = p["I7"]

    # differential pair, tail node ~0.3 V above vss
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load; M7 same density as M3 for zero systematic offset
    m3a = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=m3a.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=m3.vgs)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirrors
    mba = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=mba.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    gm7 = m7.gm
    rz = p["kz"] * (1 + cl/Cc) / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1/(m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = gm7/(m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1*A2)
    ugbw = gm1/(2*PI*Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7/(cl*(1 + C1/Cc) + C1)
    p3 = m3.gm/(2*m3.cgg + m1.cdd)
    wu = 2*PI*ugbw
    wz = 1.0/(Cc*(rz - 1.0/gm7)) if rz > 1.0/gm7 else 1e15
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu/p2)) - 0.5*math.degrees(math.atan(wu/p3)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(wu/wz))
    kT4 = 4*1.380649e-23*300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(2*kT4*0.8/gm1*(1 + m3.gm/gm1))
    noise_1k = vn_th*2.0
    power = 1.8*(iref + Itail + I7)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm,
               "power": power, "noise_1k": noise_1k}
```
